title: Spicy Jalapeño Popper Veggie Burger with Warm Bell Pepper Salad

steps.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.

Quarter jalapeño peppers lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon. Finely dice and place in a medium bowl. (Be careful with jalapeños; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Coarsely grate cheese into the bowl with the jalapeño. Add veggie ground and spices; mix with your hands until well combined. Form into 4 equal-sized patties, place on a plate, and set aside.
Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, quarter, trim, and seed bell pepper. Place in another medium bowl, drizzle with oil, and sprinkle with salt; toss to combine.
Once the skillet is hot, add bell pepper and cook, stirring occasionally, until fork-tender, about 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, place oil, vinegar, Dijon, salt, and pepper in the bowl used for the peppers. Whisk to combine the dressing.
When the peppers are done, transfer to a cutting board to cool.
Return skillet to medium-high heat, add oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add patties and cook, flipping once, until golden brown and cooked through, 8-10 minutes. Remove to a clean plate.
Once the peppers are cool enough to handle, roughly chop and transfer to the bowl with the dressing.
Separate the lettuce leaves. Set aside 1 leaf per burger and chop or tear remaining leaves into bite-sized pieces; add chopped lettuce to the bowl with the peppers and toss to combine the salad.
Place bottom half of a bun on each plate, spread with ketchup, then top with veggie burgers, lettuce, and tomato slices. Close with the top half of the bun and serve with salad on the side. Enjoy!
